markets.name: Decatur County Farmers Market
markets.about: The Decatur County Farmers Market season starts the Saturday before Easter and ends in October. The Farmers Market has over 20 farmers, bakers, artists, and food trucks twice a month. Come join the fun and support local!

markets.name: Farm Market - Trenton TN
markets.addr: 110 North Church Street Trenton, TN 38382 One block East of Gibson County Courthouse in the center of Trenton TN, behind Rosato's Italian Restaurant. Plenty of off-street parking.
